incident_text: A building is burning and firefighters are working on it.

result.scene_summary: Firefighters are spraying water on a building engulfed in flames and thick smoke, with the structure appearing partially destroyed.

observations.description: Large plume of dark smoke rising from the building.
Bright orange flames visible on the right side of the building.
Building shows signs of fire damage, including charred wood and missing sections.
Three firefighters are visible on a grassy slope, operating a hose.
A white structure, possibly a house or barn, with a sloped roof and side windows.
Green grassy slope in the foreground and trees visible in the background.

not_determinable: fire department or emergency services identifiers
